routes.notes: Expo Router system handler for verified HTTPS Gateway callbacks; accepted callbacks route to the login screen.

entry_points.notes: The +native-intent system handler validates Gateway callback URLs before routing to login.

acceptance.given: the user has valid credentials
acceptance.when: the login form is submitted
acceptance.then: the session is stored and the authenticated shell is reachable

acceptance.given: a cached session exists
acceptance.when: the app resumes or switches account
acceptance.then: server auth status is revalidated before scoped data is shown

acceptance.given: the authenticated shell is loaded
acceptance.when: the user opens the app offline
acceptance.then: the canonical five tabs remain stable and Apps is not a bottom tab

acceptance.given: Apps is hidden from the bottom tab bar
acceptance.when: the user opens Settings or the Apps shortcut
acceptance.then: the Apps index and app detail routes are reachable

scope.notes: Release、Target、commandはサーバーが解決し、Action実行は認証済みのオンラインFastAPIとIdempotency-Keyを必要とする

acceptance.given: 認証済みユーザーが読み取り可能なAppとProject bindingを開く
acceptance.when: Appsの詳細画面を表示する
acceptance.then: direct FastAPIからRelease固定のUIとopaque Action descriptorを取得し、利用不可のActionは実行できない

acceptance.given: Actionが利用可能で端末がオンラインである
acceptance.when: ユーザーがIdempotency-Key付きで送信する
acceptance.then: Release-bound runを1件だけ作成または再利用し、status・log・fileを同じscopeで再取得できる

acceptance.given: 端末がオフライン、またはユーザーのProject scopeが変わった
acceptance.when: Appsを更新するかActionを実行する
acceptance.then: cached declaration/runは読み取り専用で表示でき、Actionは無効化され、汎用sync outboxへmutationを追加しない

scope.notes: Search must filter to projects readable by the authenticated user.

acceptance.given: the user has readable old and current conversations in multiple projects plus local-only conversations
acceptance.when: a non-empty title or body query is submitted from the sidebar search icon on any panel
acceptance.then: all readable projects are searched regardless of selected scope; successful server results include local matches, offline search uses cached history, and the search header remains intact

acceptance.given: search results carry the server-owned history_status projection
acceptance.when: the user combines search with one of the four filters all, ready, needs_attention or working
acceptance.then: only results matching the projected value remain; an empty match set shows the empty state, and opening a result keeps the existing read API behavior

acceptance.given: a conversation is cached locally
acceptance.when: the user sends a message offline and reconnects
acceptance.then: the message is replayed once and project ACL is rechecked

acceptance.given: ordinary Chat and App conversations are visible with server-owned history_status values idle, ready, needs_attention or working
acceptance.when: the user opens the history filter from timeline or project view and chooses all, ready, needs_attention or working, then opens a row
acceptance.then: the selected projection value controls the list, all includes idle rows, zero matches show the filter empty state, and opening a row preserves the existing read API/read-at and refresh race semantics

acceptance.given: the sidebar shows conversations in timeline or project grouping
acceptance.when: the user long-presses a conversation and performs rename, pin, fork, copy ID, delete or local sync
acceptance.then: long press never navigates; operations use existing persistence and sync semantics, deleting the active conversation closes its route, and whole-branch fork requires complete history with explicit errors for unsupported or empty sessions

acceptance.given: the AoiTalk server is unavailable and a valid Direct LLM connection is configured
acceptance.when: the user sends with the bundled standard character or an account-and-server-scoped cached character, including after restart
acceptance.then: the requested persona and locally available tasks in the selected project or space reach the LLM without a profile API dependency; unacquired, unsynced, empty and unreadable data are distinguished

acceptance.given: a Direct reply fails or completes while the AoiTalk server is unavailable
acceptance.when: the user retries or server connectivity returns
acceptance.then: failed drafts and history remain with a retry reason, and completed Direct messages are never dispatched for server generation

scope.notes: The catalogue is ACL-filtered. Binding requires server-side session/project write authorization, Agent grant validation and CAS; Agent identity never replaces the human owner or Character presentation.

acceptance.given: the authenticated user has a scoped Agent catalogue or a previously cached catalogue
acceptance.when: the Chat Agent selector opens online or offline
acceptance.then: only safe selectable Agent projections are shown, and missing or stale choices are not treated as authorized

acceptance.given: a conversation has a current canonical Agent selection
acceptance.when: the user binds, clears or switches the selection online or from the outbox
acceptance.then: the original session scope, Agent identity and expected binding are replayed and server ACL, revision, busy-run and CAS checks reject stale mutations

acceptance.given: a message was queued with an observed Agent binding
acceptance.when: the message is replayed after reconnect
acceptance.then: the explicit expected binding prevents delivery to a different Agent, while omitted and explicit-null legacy semantics remain distinct

scope.notes: The AoiDots root is a projectless owner-scoped Agent. A project hint supplies context only; child Chat sessions, Task links and Agent execution still require their own server ACL checks.

acceptance.given: an authenticated user opens the owner-scoped AoiDots surface
acceptance.when: the user asks for a consultation with optional Project context
acceptance.then: the request uses the private root while the Project hint remains context-only and any worker is represented by a linked ordinary Chat child session

acceptance.given: an eligible Agent and optional assigned Task are available
acceptance.when: the user delegates work from AoiDots
acceptance.then: the worker Chat, AgentRun and WorkItem remain bound to the human owner and server ACL, and only bounded safe references cross the mobile boundary

acceptance.given: a delegated child asks a pending input question
acceptance.when: the user answers it
acceptance.then: the answer carries a stable client message ID plus expected input and control revisions, and stale compare-and-swap attempts are rejected

acceptance.given: a dialogue is running, paused, failed or waiting for input
acceptance.when: the user stops, resumes, reworks or restarts it
acceptance.then: the control revision advances through the canonical AgentDialogue boundary and late deliveries cannot mutate a newer generation

acceptance.given: a readable work item or pending input is returned
acceptance.when: the Chat or Operations surface renders it
acceptance.then: the client uses canonical title, label, human status, allowed actions, question, choices, input type and answer flags, while raw ledger content and provider data remain excluded

acceptance.given: the user has more than one AoiDots dialogue
acceptance.when: sessions are refreshed or reopened
acceptance.then: each dialogue keeps its own root, child Chat, Agent, pending input and artifact references without replacing another session

acceptance.given: multiple delegated dialogues run in parallel
acceptance.when: their child messages, work items and receipts settle
acceptance.then: delivery and control CAS remain isolated per dialogue so parallel work can coexist with ordinary Chat sessions

acceptance.given: the user changes account
acceptance.when: the memory screen loads
acceptance.then: only the current auth scope is read and mutations replay for that scope

acceptance.given: a task detail has local data and unsaved edits
acceptance.when: a remote refresh completes
acceptance.then: local edits, serialized autosave, tags, assignee, comments, attachments, subtasks, timer and undo semantics are preserved; task deletion creates a recoverable tombstone and undo/restore remains available for 30 days before irreversible purge

scope.notes: stale or disabled memberships must not remain visible

acceptance.given: a project is revoked or read=false
acceptance.when: the next list or sync completes
acceptance.then: the project and its dependent task/chat/file selectors disappear from every mobile surface

acceptance.given: many projects, long names, same-name Inbox projects and repeated project IDs are available
acceptance.when: a mobile scope or project selector is opened and its list refreshes
acceptance.then: all valid IDs remain selectable in a bounded scrollable searchable list, duplicate IDs appear once, and the current space/project or local/unassigned scope is identifiable without deleting data

acceptance.given: the selected project is readable
acceptance.when: a file is opened and edited offline
acceptance.then: the scoped mutation is queued and is not applied to another project

acceptance.given: a scoped document tree is cached
acceptance.when: a node is edited or moved
acceptance.then: outbox, digest, cursor and ACL scope are retained through reconnect

scope.notes: staging and atomic promotion are required

acceptance.given: a production-shaped tree has many nodes and edges
acceptance.when: sync is interrupted or the app backgrounds
acceptance.then: staging resumes without crash/data loss and promotes atomically after digest/scope checks

acceptance.given: an authenticated operator opens the sidebar
acceptance.when: Operations is selected
acceptance.then: attention and running work use vertical cards without a bottom tab or local sync table

acceptance.given: a readable work has parent and child runs
acceptance.when: its execution is opened
acceptance.then: bounded read-only main/subagent/phase/tool status is shown; out-of-scope rows and tool arguments/results are absent

acceptance.given: the server is offline or account/server scope changes
acceptance.when: a read fails or a previous request completes
acceptance.then: no healthy zero-count state or stale cross-scope response is displayed

acceptance.given: the user can read an Agent-linked conversation or run
acceptance.when: Agent history is opened
acceptance.then: live ACL-filtered bounded projections are shown; offline reads are forbidden and no Agent identity grants access to a private session
